# Jiaying Li

Senior Data Scientist focused on Search and Ranking products, product and customer questions, trustworthy measurement, self-serve analytics, and AI system evaluation.

Portfolio: https://surahli123.github.io
Email: surah123@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/surahli
GitHub: https://github.com/surahli123

## Working Style

Jiaying owns ambiguous data science problems end to end: defining the decision, identifying the right signal, modernizing the supporting dataflow, building the analysis or internal tool, evaluating system quality, and helping product teams act on the result.

Search relevance is her deepest domain and a proving ground for metric design, experimentation, ranking analysis, query understanding, and customer-centered product decisions.

## Public Work

### Search Metric Analyzer

A self-serve diagnostic platform that turns search metric movement into structured, inspectable investigations. It combines deterministic analysis, hypothesis generation, specialist investigation, synthesis, and an executive review surface.

Live demo: https://search-metric-analyzer-demo.vercel.app/
Presentation: https://search-metric-analyzer-demo.vercel.app/presentation
Source: https://github.com/surahli123/search-metric-analyzer

### Water Bottle Finance Analyzer

A bilingual executive analytics product that turns structured finance data into analysis and an executive review surface.

Live demo: https://static-kit.vercel.app/demo/fuguang-agent-dashboard-v1.html?lang=en&view=dashboard&state=normal

### DS Productivity Agents

A plugin system that packages repeatable data science review, domain guidance, and evaluation into testable workflows.

Source: https://github.com/surahli123/ds-productivity-agents
